hint: InVEST = the Integrated Valuation of Ecosystem Services and Tradeoffs software suite of the Natural Capital Project (Stanford), with modules such as habitat quality, carbon storage, water yield, sediment delivery ratio (SDR), nutrient delivery, coastal vulnerability, scenario generator. KEEP only if the paper runs, applies, couples, evaluates or compares the InVEST software or one of its modules. REJECT if 'invest/investment' is used in the financial or general sense, if INVEST is a different acronym (clinical trials, surveys, programmes), or if the paper studies ecosystem services with other tools and merely mentions InVEST in passing in the literature review.

GLM = the General Lake Model (Hipsey et al., 2019), a one-dimensional lake hydrodynamic model often coupled with AED/AED2 water-quality modules (GLM-AED). KEEP only if the paper runs, applies, calibrates, couples or evaluates the General Lake Model. REJECT if GLM means generalized linear model, general linear model, Gaussian linear model, gated linear model, geometric level modelling or any other acronym, even in limnology papers.

OGS = OpenGeoSys, the open-source finite-element simulator for thermo-hydro-mechanical-chemical processes in porous and fractured media (OGS-5, OGS-6, OpenGeoSys). KEEP only if the paper uses, develops, couples, benchmarks or evaluates OpenGeoSys. REJECT if OGS refers to anything else: the Istituto Nazionale di Oceanografia e di Geofisica Sperimentale (OGS Trieste), Oxford Glycosciences, Ohio Geological Survey, on-ground station, other acronyms.

SedCas = the SedCas sediment cascade model (Bennett et al. 2014; Hirschberg et al. 2021, ETH Zurich / WSL), a probabilistic reservoir-cascade model of sediment generation, storage and debris-flow transfer originally built for the Illgraben catchment. KEEP only if the paper runs, extends or evaluates the SedCas model itself. REJECT papers that use 'sediment cascade' only as a general geomorphological concept (sediment cascades, sediment connectivity, sediment budgets) without the SedCas model, and any other meaning of SedCas.

BFS = the Bedrock Fault Scarp model (CSDMS; Tucker et al.), a two-dimensional terrain-evolution model of normal-fault footwall scarps. KEEP only if the paper runs or develops this specific numerical model. REJECT if BFS means breadth-first search, basic feasible solution, bone-filling substances, Bachelor of Financial Services, or any other acronym, and reject field studies of bedrock fault scarps that do not use the model.

Bedrock Fault Scarp = the CSDMS numerical model (Tucker et al.) of terrain evolution on normal-fault footwall scarps. KEEP only if the paper runs or develops this specific model. REJECT field, geochronological or structural studies of bedrock fault scarps that do not use the model.

OTIS = One-Dimensional Transport with Inflow and Storage, the USGS stream solute-transport model by Runkel (1998), including OTIS-P parameter estimation. KEEP only if the paper runs, fits or evaluates this USGS transient-storage model. REJECT the OSU Tidal Inversion Software (also called OTIS, for ocean tides), elevators, satellites, and any other acronym.

AeoLiS = the process-based aeolian sediment transport model (Hoonhout and de Vries, 2016; Delft/Deltares) for supply-limited beaches and dunes, with versions AeoLiS 1 and AeoLiS 2. KEEP only if the paper runs, couples, develops or evaluates the AeoLiS model. REJECT papers about the Aeolis region of Mars (Aeolis Mons, Aeolis Quadrangle, Aeolis Dorsa), the Greek mythological Aeolis, companies named Aeolis, or aeolian processes studied without this model.

Underworld = the open-source particle-in-cell finite-element geodynamics code (Moresi et al.; Underworld, Underworld2, UWGeodynamics) for mantle convection, lithosphere deformation and basin evolution. KEEP only if the paper runs, develops or benchmarks the Underworld code. REJECT any other meaning (the criminal underworld, mythology, films, games, metaphors) and geodynamic papers that use other codes.

ISSM = the Ice-sheet and Sea-level System Model (NASA JPL / UC Irvine; Larour et al., 2012). KEEP only if the paper runs, develops or evaluates ISSM. REJECT other meanings of ISSM (integrated software systems, International Symposium on Software Metrics, interstitial, spectrometers) and ice-sheet studies that use other models.

Hogback = the CSDMS terrain-evolution model of hogback landforms (tilted resistant-layer ridges). KEEP only if the paper runs or develops this specific numerical model (it is cited as the Hogback model). REJECT descriptive geological, geomorphological or stratigraphic studies of hogback landforms, place names (Hogback Mountain, Hogback Ridge), animals, and anything else.

NEWTS = the Numerical Model of Coastal Erosion by Waves and Transgressive Scarps, a USGS cellular model of coastal cliff and lake-shore retreat (release 2023). KEEP only if the paper runs or develops this specific model. REJECT papers about newts (amphibians, salamanders), 'Newts' as a surname or nickname, and other acronyms.

Icepack here means scientific ice-modelling software named Icepack: either the icepack Python library for glacier and ice-sheet flow modelling (Shapero et al.) or the Icepack sea-ice column physics package of the CICE Consortium. KEEP if the paper runs, develops or evaluates either of these two packages. REJECT medical ice packs, cold-chain packaging, packaging machinery, 'ice pack' as sea-ice cover in descriptive studies, and papers that do not use either software.

QUODDY = the finite-element coastal ocean circulation model of the Dartmouth Numerical Methods Laboratory (Lynch et al.). KEEP only if the paper runs, couples or evaluates the QUODDY model. REJECT papers about Quoddy Head, Passamaquoddy Bay, the Quoddy region or Quoddy tidal power that do not use the model.

Symphonie = the SYMPHONIE three-dimensional coastal/regional ocean circulation model (Marsaleix et al., Laboratoire d'Aerologie, Toulouse). KEEP only if the paper runs, couples or evaluates the SYMPHONIE ocean model. REJECT music, orchestras, software products or projects named Symphonie/Symphony unrelated to this ocean model.

IGM = the Instructed Glacier Model (Jouvet et al., 2022), a machine-learning-accelerated glacier evolution model. KEEP only if the paper runs, develops or evaluates this glacier model. REJECT IgM (immunoglobulin M), intergovernmental mechanisms, inverse Gaussian models, Institute of Geophysics and Meteorology, interactive genetic/graphical models and any other acronym.

BRIE = the BarrieR Inlet Environment model (Nienhuis and Lorenzo-Trueba, 2019), a barrier-island morphodynamic model of overwash and tidal inlets. KEEP only if the paper runs, couples or develops this model. REJECT Brie cheese, Brie as a personal name or region (Brie, France), and any other acronym.

River Temperature Model here means the specific numerical heat-balance model distributed under that name (CSDMS catalogue entry 'River Temperature Model'). KEEP only if the paper runs, develops or evaluates a model that it explicitly names 'River Temperature Model' (or RTM) as a specific model. REJECT papers that simulate river or stream temperature with other named models (SNTEMP, Heat Source, HFLUX, QUAL2K, air2stream, statistical models) or that use the phrase 'river temperature model' only generically.

IceFlow = the IceFlow two-dimensional shallow-ice-approximation glacier model (CSDMS). KEEP only if the paper runs or develops this specific model. REJECT papers that use 'ice flow' generically (ice-flow velocities, ice-flow modelling with other models such as Elmer/Ice, PISM, ISSM) and software or products named IceFlow unrelated to glaciology.
